Container.Name: CLIProxyAPI
Container.Overview: Put Claude Code and Codex behind one endpoint on your own server: sign your Claude and ChatGPT subscription accounts in once, and the proxy spreads requests across them, keeps each session on one account, and uses the quota that expires soonest first.
Container.Description:
CLIProxyAPI serves the Anthropic Messages API and the OpenAI Responses API (HTTP and WebSocket) from one port and forwards each request to one of the Claude or ChatGPT subscription accounts signed in to it. A web console at /management.html manages accounts, shows each account's quota and reset times, edits the configuration, and tails the logs.
This template installs the ntindle fork, which adds routing by quota reset time, live model discovery for Claude and Codex, and a single App Data path. The first start writes a configuration with those features on.
Set Management Password before the first start. After the container is healthy, open the WebUI, sign in with that password, and add accounts under OAuth Login.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Claude Code Codex ChatGPT Anthropic OpenAI proxy gateway subscription OAuth load balancer AI agents
Container.Requires: Unofficial template for the ntindle fork of CLIProxyAPI. Set Management Password before the first start; without it the web console is disabled. The App Data path holds config.yaml, the OAuth credentials of every signed-in account, logs and plugins; treat it as a secret and back it up. Client API Keys are read only when config.yaml is first created; after that, manage keys in the web console. Keep the port on a trusted LAN or VPN such as Tailscale; do not expose it to the internet. Use only accounts you own, and check each provider's terms before routing a subscription through a proxy. Support: https://github.com/ntindle/cliproxyapi-unraid/issues

Config.Name: API and Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host TCP port mapped to container port 8317. Serves the API, the Responses WebSocket and the web console at /management.html.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent config.yaml, OAuth credentials (auths), logs, plugins and the downloaded web console. Contains secrets; include it in backups.

Config.Name: Management Password
Config.Description: Password for the web console and the management API. Required: without it the console is disabled.

Config.Name: Client API Keys
Config.Description: Comma-separated keys that Claude Code and Codex send to this proxy. Read only when config.yaml is first created; leave empty to have one generated, then read it in the web console under Config.

Config.Name: Health Check
Config.Description: The container health check probes GET /healthz over plain HTTP on port 8317. Set off if you enable TLS or change the port in config.yaml.
